description: Capabilities for the main window. IMPORTANT: this app has no local frontend at all — build.frontendDist and every window.url point at the live https://freqpanda.com site — so a Capability's permissions are inert unless `remote` explicitly lists that origin (Capability.local, defaulting to true, only covers Tauri's own asset:// local content). Without it, no permission below ever actually applies, regardless of what's listed — this is what a plain 'Command X not allowed by ACL' turned out to mean, even with a correct per-command permission defined. Scoped tightly to this app's own domain, never a wildcard, since remote+local-system access (fs, custom commands) is exactly the combination this field's own upstream doc comment warns about.
